subject: error-code: "Error in dimnames(x)" in a DIF with more than 3 groups

messages.author: 380de3bc955aac32
messages.subject: error-code: "Error in dimnames(x)" in a DIF with more than 3 groups
parts:
Hi all. 

I am doing a project in which I do a DIF analysis of a set of 9 items with 4 response categories and 8000 respondents. I have 4 groups with each 2000 respondents. I use a graded response model, and my multigroup analysis can run with the 4 groups. 
However when I do a DIF analysis with sequential drop with the 4 groups I get following error-code: "Error in dimnames(x) <- dn :
length of 'dimnames' [1] not equal to array extent
"
If I run a DIF with just two groups, no problems at all. 
When looking at the error it seems something in my inputs or coding, when I do it. 

I have attach my dataset and some R coding of what I do, and then get the error-code. 

I hope somebody can help.

Best regards,
Morten Rasmus Puck
